notes: Strength: the user's Defense -1 and Special Defense -1 on every hit (doc: "now lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def in addition to dealing damage"; no chance given, so guaranteed; same shape as Close Combat's user drops)

Checked, no override: Fell Stinger (doc says the effect was not changed, only Power 30 => 70 and PP; the table's Gen 6 Attack +2 on the KO stands); Steel Wing, Force Palm, Needle Arm, Cross Poison, Chatter, Mud Bomb, Freeze-Dry (power / PP / chance only); Rock Smash (power only in Eternal X; the table's 50 % Def -1 stands); Swagger (accuracy only; the table's Attack +2 and confusion match the doc's "sharply raises the target's Attack"); Thunder Wave, Dark Void (accuracy only); Mystical Fire (table already Sp. Atk -1 100 %); Drill Peck (crit ratio, not guaranteed); Cut (Type and crit only); Parabolic Charge / Draining Kiss / Absorb / Mega Drain (drain and power only); Ally Switch (priority only)

Not modelled, not a change: Rototiller, Flower Shield, Magnetic Flux and Gear Up (stat rises by target type / ally ability, no kind in the table); Defog (evasion only, not stored); Power Split / Guard Split / Speed Swap (stat average / swap); Extreme Evoboost (Z-move status, out of scope)
